summary: Iteration 7 tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 28/28 pass covering: POST /api/reviews (success, rating>5 → 422, quote <10 chars → 422, missing name → 422, defaults approved=false/featured=false); GET /api/reviews default returns only approved=true; ?approved=false returns unapproved (raw filter, per spec — publicly accessible currently); ?featured=true returns only approved+featured; GET /api/reviews/all → 401 unauth, 200 with admin token; PATCH approve → 200, PATCH feature → 200, PATCH non-existent → 404, PATCH unauth → 401; DELETE unauth → 401, DELETE admin → 200 (verified removal); Zoho: GET /api/auth/zoho/login → 307 redirect to accounts.zoho.eu/oauth/v2/auth with client_id, redirect_uri matching ZOHO_REDIRECT_URI env (=https://sheet-converter-68.preview.emergentagent.com/oauth/zoho/callback), state, scope; POST /api/auth/zoho/exchange with bad state → 400 'Invalid OAuth state or code'; empty body → 400; legacy GET /api/auth/zoho/callback empty → 400; /api/auth/portal/me anon → {authenticated:false}; /api/auth/portal/logout → {ok:true}; /api/portal/{invoices,projects,tickets} anon → 401. Regression: /api/contact, /api/chat (Claude 4.6), admin login all OK. Frontend Playwright: /portal anon renders 2-col layout with pear-only logo (logo-10.webp confirmed in DOM), 'Bestaande klant?' card with portal-zoho-login button, 'Nog geen toegang?' card with portal-register-form; admin login OK; sidebar shows cms-nav-reviews link; /admin/reviews renders cms-reviews page with all 4 filters (all/pending/approved/featured); seeded review appears under pending filter, review-approve-{id} click publishes, review-feature-{id} marks featured; homepage shows featured-reviews section with review-card-0 containing the seeded quote+name+company+project; cms-nav-registrations regression OK. All TEST_ seed data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~791 lines. Reviews CRUD (create/list/list-all/patch/delete) is inlined at lines 691-751 alongside registrations, contact, chat, settings, projects, auth. Strongly recommend extracting reviews into /app/backend/reviews.py router (mirror of zoho_portal.py) — this is the 3rd resource block in one file and the pattern is clear.

GET /api/reviews with ?approved=false is currently PUBLICLY accessible and returns all unapproved (pending) reviews including customer names/quotes. The review_request notes 'this is the raw filter, used from CMS earlier but is now public-open — verify current behavior matches code'. Current code (server.py:707-716) has NO auth requirement on the base /reviews route regardless of the approved param. If the intent is 'admin uses /reviews/all', then the ?approved=false leak on the public route should be closed (either require admin when approved!=True, or drop the approved param on the public route). This is a PRIVACY concern: unpublished testimonials with company names are queryable by anyone.

POST /api/reviews (create) has no rate limiting and no captcha. Public endpoint that triggers outbound admin email on every call — spam vector identical to portal register / contact. Same recommendation: add IP-throttle middleware or share the /api/chat rate limiter.

POST /api/reviews accepts any name/company/quote content — no basic profanity/HTML/URL filtering. Since these render inside FeaturedReviews on the homepage post-approval, admin is the only defense against XSS if React ever renders unescaped anywhere; today it's fine (React escapes), but if a future template uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML this becomes a stored-XSS vector.
_send_email admin notification on new review (server.py:698-702) embeds user-supplied quote inside inline HTML with no escaping. If a submitted quote contains

Review.model_config uses extra='ignore' but ReviewCreate does not — good defensive posture on the internal model. However, no server-side sanitization of leading/trailing whitespace on quote (a submission of '          ' passes min_length via .strip()? No — pydantic min_length uses raw length so 10 spaces passes). Consider @field_validator to .strip() and re-check length.
GET /api/reviews limits to 200, /reviews/all limits to 500. No pagination — will silently truncate once >500 reviews exist. Add ?skip/?limit query params before this becomes a data-visibility bug.

PATCH /api/reviews/{id} accepts {approved, featured} only. There is no way to un-feature (set featured=false) via UI easily — the frontend button pattern (review-feature-{id}) is a one-way toggle in the current AdminDashboard.jsx (verified by testids: only review-approve, review-feature, review-delete — no 'unfeature'). If admin makes a mistake, they must DELETE and re-create. Add explicit toggle-off support in UI + confirm PATCH supports it (currently does, since ReviewUpdate accepts Optional[bool]).

Zoho OAuth exchange endpoint stores portal_user_id in session (SameSite=Lax cookie 'pb_session'). Backend CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject this combination and cookies will NOT be set on real requests. This has been flagged multiple iterations; still not fixed. Since the OAuth flow depends on session for the state check between /login and /exchange, real production users on the deployed URL may see 'Invalid OAuth state' errors intermittently unless CORS is tightened.

zoho_portal.py has TWO callback endpoints for the same purpose (/api/auth/zoho/exchange POST + legacy GET /api/auth/zoho/callback, lines 73-151) — near-duplicate ~40 line blocks. Extract a shared _complete_zoho_oauth(db, code, state, session) helper.

Prior code-review from iterations 5-6 still stands (server.py growth, chat_stats loop, in-memory rate store per-worker, CORS wildcard+credentials, no dedup on registrations, chatbot system prompt outdated re: /portal path).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (portal 2-col + pear logo, admin CMS reviews approve+feature+delete, homepage featured-reviews rendering seeded review, registrations regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py (28 tests, all pass, self-cleans reviews via Mongo fixture). Reviews API: POST /api/reviews (public, no auth, no rate-limit — RATE-LIMIT/CAPTCHA MISSING), GET /api/reviews?approved=true|false&featured=true|false (public — SEE PRIVACY NOTE: approved=false publicly leaks pending reviews), GET /api/reviews/all (admin), PATCH /api/reviews/{id} {approved?,featured?} (admin), DELETE /api/reviews/{id} (admin). CMS testids: cms-nav-reviews, cms-reviews, reviews-filter-{all|pending|approved|featured}, cms-review-{id}, review-approve-{id}, review-feature-{id}, review-delete-{id}. Homepage: [data-testid=featured-reviews] with review-card-{i}. Portal: portal-zoho-login + portal-register-form both visible on unauth /portal; pear-only logo (logo-10.webp) present. Zoho endpoints: /api/auth/zoho/login (302 to accounts.zoho.eu, redirect_uri from env), /api/auth/zoho/exchange (POST, needs matching session state — hard to test end-to-end w/o real Zoho user), /api/auth/zoho/callback (legacy GET, still 400s on empty), /api/auth/portal/{me,logout}, /api/portal/{invoices,projects,tickets} all require Zoho session. CORS wildcard+credentials issue still unfixed (session cookies won't set from browser).
